page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-8 is an Arm-based virtual machine instance within the Standard compute series. It is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores on the Ampere AmpereOne processor family operating at 3.0 GHz. Because it uses single-threaded physical cores without simultaneous multithreading, each vCPU provides predictable compute execution without cross-thread resource contention. Memory capacity is provisioned at 8.0 GB, establishing a balanced 1:4 allocation of 4.0 GB RAM per dedicated core.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage, requiring persistent workloads to rely on remote block storage solutions. Accelerated computing hardware is also absent, with a GPU count of zero. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Given the dedicated Arm core architecture and moderate resource scale, this shape provides predictable performance efficiency for baseline containerized applications, development staging, microservices, and general-purpose web serving.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine utilizing the 64-bit Arm architecture. Built on the Ampere AmpereOne processor running at 3.0 GHz, the instance supplies 2 dedicated vCPUs corresponding to 2 single-threaded physical cores. System memory totals 8.0 GB, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core without hyperthreading interference. This shape includes no local storage or discrete graphics processing units, relying entirely on network-attached storage for disk operations. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Combining dedicated Arm compute resources with a standard memory profile, VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-8 delivers consistent processing capacity suited for lightweight web servers, container deployment nodes, application backends, and ongoing development or continuous integration pipelines.
